title: Pure Centur-Ion
summary: Pure Centur-Ion Synchro strategy utilizing its signature Trap-monster mechanic alongside the 2024 support wave and generic staples. By placing Centur-Ion monsters in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Traps, the deck summons them during either player's Main Phase to perform instant Quick Synchro Summons into towering Level 12 bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Centur-Ion Primera is the core Level 4 Tuner: Normal or Special Summoned, it adds any Centur-Ion card from Deck to hand, and while face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone it shields big Centur-Ions from effect destruction.
Centur-Ion Trudea places itself and another Centur-Ion monster from hand or Deck face-up in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Traps, and summons itself back as a Level 8 non-Tuner.

Stand Up Centur-Ion! discards a card on activation to place a Centur-Ion monster from Deck face-up into the Spell & Trap Zone, and triggers a Quick Synchro Summon whenever a monster is Special Summoned.
Emblema Oath either places a Centur-Ion monster from Deck face-up as a Continuous Trap or Sets a Centur-Ion Spell/Trap directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Centur-Ion Primera + Stand Up Centur-Ion!
steps: Activate Stand Up Centur-Ion!, sending a card from hand to GY to place Centur-Ion Trudea face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
Normal Summon Centur-Ion Primera, using its effect to add Emblema Oath (or Centur-Ion True Awakening) from Deck to hand.

During either Main Phase, activate Trudea's effect in the Spell & Trap Zone to Special Summon itself, then activate its on-field effect to become Level 8 and place Centur-Ion Gargoyle II (or Emeth VI) from Deck into your Spell & Trap Zone.
Special Summon Gargoyle II from the Spell & Trap Zone by lowering its Level by 4 (to Level 4) or keep Trudea at Level 8.
During the opponent's Main Phase, activate Stand Up Centur-Ion! to Quick Synchro Summon Centur-Ion Legatia or Centur-Ion Auxila using Level 4 Tuner Primera and Level 8 Trudea.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Centur-Ion Legatia on Synchro Summon draws 1 card, destroys the opponent's monster with the highest ATK, and places a Centur-Ion monster from GY into the Spell & Trap Zone in the End Phase.
Centur-Ion Auxila searches any Centur-Ion card on summon, protects your face-up cards in the Spell & Trap Zone from destruction, and re-places a Centur-Ion into the backrow in the End Phase.
Centur-Ion Primera Primus is a Level 8 Synchro Tuner that searches an Emblema card and destroys a card on each side of the field.
Crimson Dragon targets a Level 12 Synchro (such as Legatia or Auxila) to return itself to the Extra Deck and cheat out Cosmic Blazar Dragon.
Cosmic Blazar Dragon provides an omni-negate by banishing itself until the End Phase to negate a summon, card effect activation, or attack.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Stand Up Centur-Ion! enables Quick Synchro Summons on the opponent's turn and boosts Centur-Ion monsters by 100 ATK for each card in your Spell & Trap Zone.
Centur-Ion True Awakening sends a face-up monster card from your Spell & Trap Zone to the GY to negate any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation and destroy it.
Centur-Ion Phalanx banishes a monster on the field until the next Standby Phase, and banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon a Centur-Ion Synchro from your GY.
Wake Up Centur-Ion! summons a Level 4 or Level 8 Token to adjust Levels for Synchro plays and dumps a Centur-Ion from the Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Hot Red Dragon Archfiend King Calamity is left out as it is Forbidden in the TCG. The Crimson Dragon line here pivots purely into legal bosses like Cosmic Blazar Dragon.
